goal: Implement an authenticated bounded Journal upsert/delete acknowledgement contract locally; persistent soft-delete tombstones prevent a delayed upsert from making a deleted row visible.
successCriteria: Missing configuration/auth cannot return synced; authenticated user ownership comes only from getUser.
Legacy upsert and explicit upsert/delete return truthful matching ACK; delete writes a content-cleared tombstone even if entry is not yet on server.
Tests cover wrong-user targeting, late upsert after delete, malformed/oversized payloads, invalid remote ACK and server failures; no claim cross-client deletion broadcast without read contract.
untouchedSurfaces: No DB schema/RLS/migration push/repair, live deletion, deployment or provider.
No App/backendClient remote-read changes; two-client tombstone delivery remains explicitly pending.

impact.entryPoint: POST journal-entries called by durable local outbox.
impact.dataWrite: On authorized future deployment only: journal_entries own user/local-id upsert or soft-delete content-cleared tombstone. Local task writes code/tests only.
impact.backendContract: Add operation delete/upsert to current optional-operation POST, exact localId/operation ACK, UUID upsert ACK, config/auth strict.
impact.adminVisibility: No private content or raw database error returned to Admin/logs.
impact.privacySafety: Verified user + explicit owner filters; no service-role client, secret content not in error output.
impact.observability: Truthful ACK/server status; no offline mock synced.
impact.rollback: Local code revert safe; forward deployed endpoint retains legacy upsert and existing deleted_at column; review old-client compatibility before rollout.

canonicalContracts: Existing journal mobile contract unique(user_id,local_id), deleted_at and RLS remain unchanged.
Delete is soft tombstone with content cleared, not cloud account deletion; GET must deliver tombstones for other devices in future slice.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Fresh whole-app and additive legacy contract, local test versus deployment/cross-client/native gates separated.

dependencyReview.evidence: Existing React refs/state and callbacks, no package or API choice.

securityReview.authzRls: JWT getUser identity and explicit owner key; caller user_id ignored, use anon+JWT and existing RLS.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Synthetic bounded journal fixtures; no private/live data.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Generic errors; no credentials or input content logging.
securityReview.externalInput: Streaming body bound128KiB, strict field limits/types, known source type, valid timestamp and snapshot64KiB.
securityReview.dependencies: Existing pinned Supabase createClient and Deno2.9 installed; pure test handler no remote imports.
securityReview.migrationRelease: Foreign MCY staging remains blocked; no deploy/db apply.
securityReview.stopCondition: Stop live action or fakeACK; record missing cross-client broadcast/atomic revision gate.

workingTreeReview.note: Backend agent transferred exact R07server scope to root; old handler unchanged at start, preserve all other owner functions.

managerTestPath: Review synthetic owner A/B fixture tests; after R02/deployment use disposable accounts with save/delete/restart and two-client readback.
residualRisk: No live RLS/database compatibility, transaction/CAS or cross-client tombstone propagation acceptance; soft-delete retention/cloud account deletion separate.
nativeDeliveryReview: Installed Expo Sharing Android resolves on chooser ActivityResult, which does not prove recipient finished reading. iOS removes after sheet; Android retains only app-private named export for 10 minutes, schedules deletion and startup cleanup; no unrelated files scanned/deleted. Native receiver/device verification remains separate.
